values.subject: Grant G-2021-0427 personal deadline and portal maintenance compensation
values.body_text: Your last working day is June 30, 2026. The portal is now open. The personal deadline for Grant G-2021-0427 is confirmed as October 5, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time. Exercise quantity, payment, and confirmation must be completed by you. The assistant cannot submit exercise or other irreversible processing.
